title: 좋아하는 것과 싫어하는 것: 뭘 좋아해요?
objective: By the end, you can say what you like, dislike, and are interested in using short sentences. You will also use the right particle: 을/를 with 좋아하다/싫어하다, 이/가 with 싫다, and 에 with 관심이 있다.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for saying what you like, dislike, and are interested in.

task.title: Use the new words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, or put the words in order using the words on page 1.

words.meaning: to like (the thing you like takes 을/를)
to dislike, to hate (the thing takes 을/를)
words.exampleMeaning: My younger sibling hates rainy days.

words.meaning: to not like, to be unpleasant (the thing takes 이/가)
interest (N에 관심이 있다 = to be interested in N)
words.exampleMeaning: I'm interested in Korean cooking these days.

words.meaning: to be fun, to be interesting
words.exampleMeaning: This drama is really fun to watch.

words.meaning: to be boring, to be no fun
words.exampleMeaning: That movie was a bit boring.
Which sport do you like the most?

words.meaning: not really, not very (used with 안 or a negative word)
to like something you see or get, to suit your taste (the thing takes 이/가)
words.exampleMeaning: I like the bag I just bought.

exercises: Choose the right particle: ① 저는 고양이(를 / 가) 좋아해요. ② 저는 여름(을 / 이) 싫어요.
Fill in the blank with one word from page 1: 제 친구는 사진에 ____이 많아요.
Choose the word that fits: 그 책은 너무 (재미있어서 / 재미없어서) 다 안 읽었어요.
Fill in the blank with the word that means 'not really': 저는 야구를 ____ 안 좋아해요.
Fill in each blank with 취미 or 마음에 들어요: ① 주말에는 제 ____인 그림을 그려요. ② 이 모자 색깔이 정말 ____.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 싫어해요 / 오빠는 / 당근을 / 제일
answers: 오빠는 당근을 제일 싫어해요. (또는: 오빠는 제일 당근을 싫어해요.)
